paths.description: Project-relative, POSIX-separated path globs. Strict segment semantics: `*` matches within a single path segment and never crosses `/`; `**` crosses `/`; `?` matches exactly one non-`/` character; `[...]` character classes are supported; dotfiles are matched.

commands.description: Shell command-line patterns with loose wildcard semantics: `*` matches any run of characters and does cross `/`, so `rm -rf *` also matches `rm -rf /tmp/x`. A command line is not a `/`-segmented namespace.

tools.description: Tool or sub-Agent identifiers with loose wildcard semantics: `*` matches any run of characters, including `/`.

hosts.description: Network hosts with loose wildcard semantics: `*` matches any run of characters, including `/`.

mcpServers.description: MCP server names with loose wildcard semantics: `*` matches any run of characters, including `/`.

stages.description: Flow Stages the policy applies to. No host's static permission format can express Stage scoping, so a Stage-scoped policy is withheld from every static projection and enforced only by the XForge runtime Hook bridge.

exceptActors.description: Agent identities the policy does not apply to. No host's static permission format can express an actor exception, so a policy using this is withheld from every static projection and enforced only by the XForge runtime Hook bridge, which does honour it.
